notes.title: Steam Deck Support
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429108/900e43da59a58bddd0f060cdb4b0c4a33c50205b.png[/img]

We haven't forgotten about you Steam Deck players!

Using the Steam Input system we have created a default controller scheme for the Steam Deck, so that when you launch the game the controls will feel smooth without you having to set it up from scratch.

During development we were careful to make sure that the game looks and runs great, so you'll have no issues completing a full playthrough exclusively on your Steam Deck.

Perhaps you are bored of scrolling your phone in the bathroom? Now you can play Overencumbered In Another World instead!

Before I sign off, I just wanted to thank everyone who has played so far! We've loved seeing such a positive reception for the game.

notes.title: Overencumbered In Another World, Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429108/3ca0d3f0c2942c516c80dfc8fb4cf65c2b218cc2.png[/img]

Overencumbered In Another World is out now!

The time has come to fire up your brain and solve [b]all 80 puzzles[/b]. Hopefully you have as much fun playing it as we've had making it.

If you have any [b]bug reports[/b], [b]feature requests[/b] or just want to let us know you enjoyed your time in another world, we'd love to hear from you. We will be monitoring the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2275100/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] and our [b]support inbox[/b] very closely.

That's all for now, look out for announcements over the next few days with details about out future plans.

notes.title: Demo Update - Version 2.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429108/0a28278467c171b2521fbcb0e2d01747717535ac.png[/img]

In anticipation of the full game launch today, we have updated the demo version of the game.

The new demo now features updated content to align directly with v1.0 of Overencumbered In Another World.

This includes the below:
[list]
[*] Improved visuals
[*] More voicelines to help you get immersed in the world
[*] Updated music
[*] Updated level designs (including 3 additional levels, good luck they are hard!)
[*] Many more changes!
[/list]
If you'd like to try before you buy, this new demo is for you!

notes.title: Overencumbered In Another World - Releasing 2nd May
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429108/455d3e5948e28c8e30129c402db65e8d80aa99ac.png[/img]

We are happy to announce that Overencumbered In Another World will be releasing in just 2 weeks!

Mark the date in your calendar - 2nd May 2025.

If you haven't already, you can play through Chapter 1 of the game in the demo here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3460390/Overencumbered_In_Another_World_Demo/]Overencumbered In Another World Demo[/url]

notes.title: Demo Patch - v1.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429108/245cb01c6ead7eebc75cc0636cf174240a45af96.png[/img]

Thank you to everyone who has played the demo and wishlisted the game so far. 
We are reading all of your feedback.

In response to that feedback here are some updates we have made to the demo.

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Only English language will now display in game (Support for additional languages will be added following the full game release)
[*] Alt click menu now closes when opening confirmation windows
[/list]
Changes:
[list]
[*] Text now displays on cutscenes for the pause/skip keybind
[*] Timed tip voicelines now play half as often as before
[/list]
